map.由 A=λN 与 λ=ln2/th 消元得 th=N·ln2/A。: Eliminating λ between A = λN and λ = ln2/th gives th = N·ln2/A.
map.测定时假设核数仅因衰变减少、无增减来源，否则需校正。: The measurement assumes the number of nuclei falls only through decay, with no other source or sink; otherwise a correction is needed.
map.由核数与活度反推半衰期：t½ = N·ln2 ÷ A（秒，N 原子核数、A 活度: Half-life back-solved from nucleus count and activity: t½ = N·ln2 ÷ A (seconds, N number of nuclei, A activity in Bq, derived from λ = A/N and t½ = ln2/λ); linked values: decay constant λ = ln2 ÷ t½ (1/s), half-life (days) = t½÷86400, half-life (years) = t½ ÷ 3.156×10⁷, nucleus-to-activity ratio = N÷A (s). Validation: required guards for N and A, and A as a denominator must not be 0. Criteria: no fixed grading; t½ is proportional to the nucleus count and inversely proportional to the activity.
